answer: Sybil resistance via verifiable-delay gatekeeping: each identity must compute a lantern-proof—chaining VDF iterations impossible to parallelize—before earning governance weight. Seeded at network dawn, genesis binds every identity to an unforgeable sequential timeline. Cloning duplicates only the stated walnut of credentials, not wall-clock burned; a thousand clones need a thousand sequential runs. VDF output verifies instantly but produces slowly, converting mass fabrication from a cheap batching attack into a linear hardware-bound waiting cost attackers pay up front.
